description: Sign-in required: call connect(email) and connect_verify first (free, one email) unless this connection is already signed in. A document's identity and its table of contents (turinys), WITHOUT its text. Call this before reading: the Civil Code (Civilinis kodeksas) runs to 1.7 million characters. Ids come from search results (įstatymas or nutartis). An ECHR id (`coe.hudoc:`) or application number gives the case's catalogue card: Avokata holds no ECHR text - read it at `text_availability.where` (HUDOC).

contents_limit.description: Optional: unit rows per page with `contents_offset`, default 400, at most 1,000 (a page also ends early to stay within the answer's size, and says where the next one starts).
contents_limit.title: Contents Limit

contents_offset.description: Optional: list the contents as unit rows from this position (0 = the first unit). A long document's contents otherwise come by chapter; every answer states the true total (`contents_page.units_total`) and the next offset.
contents_offset.title: Contents Offset

document_id.description: The `id` of a search hit, or the `document.id` beside it. NOT `document.number`, which is the act's official number (`XIII-2221`) and is not an id.
document_id.title: Document Id

jurisdiction.description: Which jurisdiction the id belongs to (`LT`). Omit for the account's own.
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

part.description: Optional: one chapter or approved document of a long act - a label from its contents' `location` (`IV SKYRIUS`, `Darbo laiko ir poilsio laiko ypatumų ... aprašas`). Lists that part's units only; without it a long act's contents come by chapter.
part.title: Part

session.description: The `session` value the sign-in returned. Pass it on every call in this conversation, so the sign-in survives however this client handles connections; omit it when the user connected with Sign in (OAuth) or a key.

name: get_document
title: Document and contents
